In the PCR step of TILLING, mutant DNA anneals to wild-type DNA to form these structures that Cel1 endonucleases can cleave at. This kind of DNA is formed from single strands that originate from different sources.

Only plant lines exhibiting this quality can be used during TILLING. Organisms exhibiting this quality and low fitness typically display a high frequency of deleterious homozygous alleles in their genome.

bonuses.leadin: Krišjānis (“kree-SHAWN-ees”) Barons designed a giant cabinet to collect over 150,000 texts of this type of folk song. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this traditional type of Latvian folk song, which is often accompanied by the kokles zither.

The daina folk songs of this country are closely related to the Latvian daina. Latvia and this southern neighbor are the only two where a language of the Baltic branch of the Indo-European family is official.

Latvians sing songs with a refrain of līgo on this holiday, which they call Jāṇi (“YAWN-yee”). Kupala Night celebrations, which inspired Mussorgsky’s Night on Bald Mountain, are performed as part of this holiday.

bonuses.leadin: John von Neumann introduced the notion of amenable groups while studying the algebraic properties that make this result possible. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this counterintuitive result which states that the group action of SO(3) admits a “paradoxical decomposition” into disjoint pieces that may be rearranged to form two copies of the original set.

Based on the Banach–Tarski proof, Von Neumann falsely conjectured that all non-amenable groups contain this group as a subgroup. This is the fundamental group of a singly punctured torus, or S-one wedge S-one.
The Banach–Tarski paradox concerns decompositions of these sets consisting of all points in space that are a fixed distance from a center point.

bonuses.leadin: This town emerged after Samuel Blodgett built a canal system around the Amoskeag Falls on the Merrimack River. For 10 points:
parts: Name this town home to the mills of the Amoskeag Manufacturing Company, which, for a time, was the world’s largest cotton textile plant.
The Amoskeag mills produced this type of fabric for Levi Strauss, the first to make blue jeans using this characteristic fabric.

The Amoskeag mills advertised in this country for experienced weavers in particular. Immigrants followed the teachings of a theologian from this country who wrote The First Blast of the Trumpet against the Monstrous Regiment of Women.

bonuses.leadin: Two answers required. This brand and this celebrity designer collaborated to create black and sandy-hued cars much-loved by rappers circa 2022 and 2023. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this sub-brand of Mercedes and namesake of Rick Ross’s music imprint, as well as the now-deceased celebrity designer they collaborated with; that designer also directed the music video for “XO Tour Llif 3.”
This rapper used an offroad, solar-powered Abloh Maybach in a 2022 music video. The album Honestly, Nevermind was dedicated to Abloh by this artist of NOKIA and God’s Plan.
Drake’s offroad Abloh Maybach appeared in the video for a 2022 song with this name. A 2024 posse cut with this name included features from Lil Wayne, GloRilla, and Sexyy Red.

bonuses.leadin: Kwame Gyekye (“KWAH-may JAY-chay”) has argued that Kwasi Wiredu’s understanding of the role of this concept among the Akan produces a tyranny of this concept over the individual. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this concept, which names an ethical viewpoint developed by Thaddeus Metz. On Wiredu’s account, this concept grants personhood to individuals among the Akan.
Wiredu’s conception of personhood within Akan communities has been critiqued by Gyekye as overly subjugating the ends of the individual, arguments which invoke this Kantian ethical principle.
Beyond the Akan, communitarianism in precolonial Africa has been championed using the phrase “I am because we are,” a key tenant in this philosophy.
